## Why visit

A worthwhile targeted visit for Neptune’s own beers in a comfortable community bar. This is a beerhouse rather than a production-floor tour: benches, sofas and a conversational setting give the brewery’s cask and keg a different context from a warehouse taproom. The range includes new and collaborative beers, making it useful if Neptune has caught your attention in central pubs. Pairing it with Scotch Piper can make a varied north-of-Liverpool day, provided you plan the bus connections and opening days carefully.

## Beer

Operator advertises four cask and eight keg taps, principally Neptune beers.

## Food

Monthly Two Cents Pizza pop-ups; do not assume food on every opening day.

## Plan the visit

Normally Thursday–Sunday. Operator address is 23–25; CAMRA gives 25–27, so use the venue pin and check directly. This is not the brewery production address.

**Getting there:** Maghull rail plus a local walk/bus; Liverpool Road North also has bus stops.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
